Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Persistent Seiton decisions, personal PvP warnings, and an optional Purify buffer.
Description: A local Crystalline Conflict reaction-cue HUD. Ninja gets persistent PREP and SHIFT+slot Seiton decisions; every job can see Wildfire, Death Warrant, Stun, and Miracle warnings. The experimental one-key/one-attempt Purify buffer is disabled by default.
